tools.name: search_history
tools.title: Search BetterRecall history
tools.description: Search what the user saw or heard on this PC. Hybrid keyword and semantic search over window titles, app names, on-screen text, keyframe images and audio transcripts. Returns JSON with results (id, ts, kind, app, title, score, snippet) and nextCursor when more results exist (agent limits ipc.defaultResults and ipc.maxResults apply).

q.description: What to look for, natural language or keywords. 1 to 1024 characters.

limit.description: Maximum results per page (defaults to ipc.defaultResults; agent maximum ipc.maxResults applies).

from.description: Only results at or after this ISO 8601 time.

to.description: Only results before this ISO 8601 time.

app.description: Process image name, for example chrome.exe.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous search_history nextCursor.

tools.name: get_capture
tools.title: Get one capture
tools.description: Full stored text of one search result: the on-screen text (private details removed) for screen captures, or the window title when no text was read; the transcript for audio.

tools.name: recall_status
tools.title: BetterRecall status
tools.description: Whether BetterRecall is capturing, paused or locked, and store statistics.
